essential_conclusion: Every finite width-at-most-three POS3 counterexample has connected comparability graph. If comparability components are P_i, uniform extensions factor as independent uniform component extensions times a uniform shuffle, so internal pair probabilities are preserved and width is additive. Disconnected comparability forces every component to width at most two; the width-two theorem then supplies a balanced pair. Combined with the prior incomparability-component reduction, a cardinality-minimal counterexample is both series- and parallel-indecomposable. Deleting one member of a proper autonomous chain of size at least two preserves comparability connectivity too, so the unresolved one-step inflation problem stays inside the bi-connected width-three hard class.
